mapper.insert: MERGE INTO email_auth USING dual ON (email = #{email}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET auth_code = #{authCode}, create_time = SYSTIMESTAMP, is_verified = 'N' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (email, auth_code, create_time, is_verified, request_ip) VALUES (#{email}, #{authCode}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N', #{requestIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_AUTH SET IS_VERIFIED = 'Y' WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM EMAIL_AUTH WHERE email = #{email} AND is_verified = 'Y' AND create_time >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL
